notes: The Better Auth tables stay in src/db/schema.ts in the layout the existing database has (camelCase columns, ISO-text dates), not the recipe's src/db/authSchema.ts, because the production data already uses them; Better Auth 1.7's schema check passes against them (src/server/authFlow.test.ts).

createAuth takes a third argument, `generatedSecret()`: when none of BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS, or AUTH_SECRET is set, it reads `$DATA_DIR/auth.secret`, which ras-stack 4's persistedSecret generated, so deployments that relied on that file keep their sessions; the production guard accepts AUTH_SECRET or the file too. Better Auth reads AUTH_SECRET itself.
emailAndPassword sets `minPasswordLength` to the product's PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH, and the verification-email comment explains why verification is not required.
`me` returns only the user's id, name, and email to the browser, not the whole Better Auth user.
The sign-in, forgot-password, and reset-password pages are the product's own (src/routes/signin.tsx and siblings) and keep controlled inputs.
The database file is `$DATA_DIR/sealed-lists.sqlite`, the name deployments already have, in src/db/database.ts, scripts/database.ts, and their tests.
src/db/schema.ts and drizzle/ are the application's own, with its existing migration history; the recipe's starter `note` table and `0000_init` migration were not used.
src/server/database.test.ts writes a `groups` row instead of the starter `note` table.
package.json keeps `db:check` (`drizzle-kit check`) in `pnpm check`.
SMTP rather than email-posthog: Sealed Lists is open source and self-hostable, and its operators bring their own mail server; the recipe guide's 'mail server someone else configures' case.
authEmails carries the product's existing plain-text reset and verification copy, without the HTML part, and the authEmails tests assert that copy.
Game-started and game-revealed emails are built in src/server/emails.ts and sent through the same delivery by src/server/notify.ts, which skips them when no delivery is configured.

Production images are built by the `production-image` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml after a Changesets release, not by deploy.yml, so the source-map build arguments and upload secret are passed there.
src/routes/__root.tsx keeps the product's head tags, header, footer, toaster, and `meQuery` loader; the update notice uses the app's brass and floor colours instead of amber.
src/router.tsx keeps the app's `RouteError` default error component and its 'Nothing here' not-found page.
src/client/queryClient.ts also exports `errorMessage`, which the pages use to show a failed call's message.
src/server/contentSecurityPolicy.ts adds `worker-src 'self' blob:` for PostHog session replay's compression worker, as the app's previous policy allowed.
src/routes/api/health.ts maps a failure to `database_unavailable`, the code monitors already saw.
vite.config.ts keeps `server.allowedHosts: ['host.docker.internal']` only while the Centrifugo connect proxy calls back into the dev server.
AGENTS.md is a symlink to CLAUDE.md, which holds the recipe's paragraph beside the product's agent guide.
tsconfig.json keeps the `@/*` path alias and vitest.config.ts sets `resolve.tsconfigPaths`, because the shadcn components under src/components/ui import through `@/`.
.oxlintrc.json also ignores src/components/ui/**, which `shadcn add` generates.
pnpm-workspace.yaml keeps the peerDependencyRules entry that lets better-auth's better-sqlite3 peer range accept version 13.
